app.title: Video Publisher
app.subtitle: Publish one video to several social networks at once

settings.title: Settings
settings.networksHint: Click a network to open its settings.

telegram.title: Telegram
telegram.modeBotHint: The app publishes the post. The computer must be on or asleep at publish time. Videos up to 50 MB.
telegram.modeAccountHint: Telegram stores scheduled posts — they go out even if the computer is off. Videos up to 2 GB.
telegram.botTokenHint: Get it from @BotFather. The bot must be an admin of the channel.
telegram.apiHint: Keys of your own Telegram app. How to get them: open my.telegram.org, sign in with your phone number, choose “API development tools”, create an app (any name) and copy the api_id and api_hash.

login.title: Account sign-in
login.needKeys: Save the api_id and api_hash first — sign-in needs them.
login.codeSentTo: The code was sent in Telegram to {{phone}}.
login.passwordNeeded: Two-step verification is on. Enter your Telegram cloud password.
login.stored: The session is stored in Windows Credential Manager. The number, code and password are not saved.

facebook.intro: You need your own Meta app (developers.facebook.com) and a Page you manage. While the app is in development mode, login works for you without Meta's review.
facebook.appSecretHint: In the Meta app: App settings → Basic.
facebook.redirectHint: If Facebook says the address is not allowed, add it in the Meta app (Facebook Login → Settings → Valid OAuth Redirect URIs):

login.title: Log in with Facebook
login.needKeys: Save the App ID and App Secret first; login needs them.
login.waiting: A browser window opened. Log in to Facebook and allow access to the Page; the app will wait.
login.choosePage: You manage several Pages. Choose where to publish:
login.stored: The Page token is kept in Windows Credential Manager. The app never sees your Facebook password.

youtube.intro: You need your own Google Cloud project with YouTube Data API v3 enabled and an OAuth client of type “Desktop app”. While the project is in testing, only accounts listed under Test users can log in.
youtube.clientSecretHint: Google Cloud → Google Auth Platform → Clients → your “Desktop app” client.
youtube.auditHint: Until your Google project passes the YouTube audit, every video uploaded through the API stays private (visible only to you), and you need to log in again every 7 days.

login.title: Log in with Google
login.needKeys: Save the Client ID and Client Secret first; you cannot log in without them.
login.waiting: A browser window opened. Choose the account with your channel and allow access to YouTube; the app is waiting.
login.stored: The login key is kept in Windows Credential Manager. The app never sees your Google password.

defaults.title: Video defaults
defaults.privacyHint: For a scheduled video YouTube uploads it as private and makes it public at the chosen time.
defaults.tagsHint: Separated by commas, 500 characters in total. Hashtags from the upload screen go into the description.

secret.placeholderReplace: Paste a new value to replace it

fieldErrors.greater_than: Value must be greater than zero
fieldErrors.invalid_app_id: The App ID is a number of 5–20 digits
fieldErrors.invalid_category: Choose a category from the list
fieldErrors.invalid_tag: Tags cannot contain < > or a comma inside a tag
fieldErrors.youtube_tags_too_long: All tags together are longer than 500 characters. Remove some.

errors.invalid_bot_token: This does not look like a bot token. Format: 123456789:AA…
errors.invalid_api_hash: api_hash is 32 characters of digits and letters a–f
errors.video_not_found: File not found. It may have been moved or deleted.
errors.telegram_unsupported_format: An MP4 file is required. Convert the video to MP4 and try again.
errors.telegram_bot_file_too_large: The file is larger than 50 MB, which bots cannot send. Choose “My account” in settings (videos up to 2 GB) and sign in.
errors.caption_too_long: The caption is longer than {{max}} characters ({{length}}). Please shorten it.
errors.telegram_invalid_token: Telegram rejected the bot token. Check it in settings.
errors.telegram_chat_not_found: Channel not found. Check the channel name in settings and that the bot was added to it.
errors.telegram_bot_not_admin: The bot cannot post to the channel. Make it an admin with the “Post messages” right.
errors.telegram_rate_limited: Telegram asks to wait {{retry_after}} s. Please try later.
errors.telegram_unavailable: Telegram is unavailable right now. Please try later.
errors.telegram_timeout_uncertain: The connection dropped during upload. Check the channel: the post may have gone out. It was not retried automatically to avoid a duplicate.
errors.telegram_bot_no_native_scheduling: Bots cannot schedule posts natively in Telegram.
errors.network_error: No internet connection or the network is unavailable.
errors.telegram_not_configured: Telegram is not set up: enter the channel and bot token in settings.
errors.platform_not_supported: This platform is not supported yet.
errors.interrupted: The app was closed during upload. Check the channel: the post may have gone out.
errors.telegram_account_file_too_large: The file is larger than 2 GB ({{size_mb}} MB). Telegram accepts videos up to {{max_mb}} MB.
errors.telegram_account_not_configured: The Telegram account is not set up: enter the channel, api_id and api_hash in settings and sign in.
errors.telegram_account_not_admin: Your account cannot post in this channel. It needs to be an admin with the “Post messages” right.
errors.telegram_schedule_limit: The channel has too many scheduled posts (Telegram allows 100). Wait for some to go out or delete them.
errors.telegram_flood_wait: Telegram asks to wait {{seconds}} s. Try again after that.
errors.telegram_api_keys_invalid: Telegram rejected the api_id or api_hash. Check them at my.telegram.org.
errors.telegram_api_keys_missing: Save the api_id and api_hash first.
errors.telegram_session_expired: The account sign-in is no longer valid (for example, the session was ended on another device). Sign in again in settings.
errors.telegram_phone_invalid: Invalid phone number. Use the international format, e.g. +15551234567.
errors.telegram_phone_banned: This number is banned in Telegram.
errors.telegram_phone_not_registered: There is no Telegram account for this number.
errors.telegram_code_invalid: Wrong code. Check the code from Telegram and try again.
errors.telegram_code_expired: The code has expired. Request a new one.
errors.telegram_too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Telegram has temporarily limited sign-in, try again later.
errors.telegram_login_failed: Could not sign in to Telegram. Please try again.
errors.telegram_already_logged_in: Already signed in. Sign out first to switch accounts.
errors.telegram_login_not_started: Sign-in was not started or was interrupted. Request a new code.
errors.schedule_in_past: The publish time has passed or is too close. Pick a time at least {{min_minutes}} min from now.
errors.schedule_too_far: Posts can be scheduled at most {{max_days}} days ahead.
errors.schedule_timezone_required: The publish time has no time zone.
errors.scheduling_not_supported: This publishing method cannot schedule posts. For Telegram choose “My account” in settings.
errors.file_dialog_failed: Could not open the file dialog. Drag the video into the app window instead.
errors.publication_in_progress: The video is still uploading. You can delete the record once it finishes.
errors.cancel_needs_method: The post was scheduled with the "{{method}}" method. Switch Telegram to it in Settings to cancel the post.
errors.cancel_not_supported: This network cannot cancel a scheduled post.
errors.invalid_app_secret: The App Secret is 32 characters of digits and letters a–f
errors.facebook_not_configured: Facebook is not set up: log in with Facebook in Settings.
errors.facebook_app_not_configured: Save the App ID and App Secret of your Meta app first.
errors.facebook_already_logged_in: Already logged in. Log out first to switch Pages.
errors.facebook_port_busy: Port {{port}} for the Facebook login is used by another program. Close it and try again.
errors.facebook_login_denied: The Facebook login was cancelled or access was not allowed.
errors.facebook_no_pages: Facebook found no Pages you manage, or access to them was not granted. Log in again and tick the Page.
errors.facebook_page_not_offered: This Page is not in the list. Log in with Facebook again.
errors.facebook_token_invalid: Access to the Facebook Page no longer works (for example, the password changed or access was removed). Log in again in Settings.
errors.facebook_rate_limited: Facebook is limiting requests for now. Try again later.
errors.facebook_unavailable: Facebook is unavailable right now. Try again later.
errors.facebook_permission_denied: No permission to publish on this Page. Log in again and allow publishing.
errors.facebook_video_rejected: Facebook did not accept the video. Check the file: MP4, not damaged.
errors.facebook_page_not_found: The Page or video was not found on Facebook.
errors.facebook_timeout_uncertain: The connection dropped during the upload. Check the Page: the video may be out. It was not retried automatically to avoid a duplicate.
errors.facebook_unsupported_format: An MP4 file is needed. Convert the video to MP4 and try again.
errors.facebook_file_too_large: The file is over 1 GB ({{size_mb}} MB). Facebook accepts up to {{max_mb}} MB in a single upload.
errors.facebook_title_too_long: The title is longer than {{max}} characters ({{length}}). Shorten it.
errors.invalid_client_secret: This does not look like a Client Secret. Copy it from Google Cloud (it usually starts with GOCSPX-).
errors.youtube_already_logged_in: You are already logged in to YouTube. Log out first to switch channels.
errors.youtube_app_not_configured: Save the Client ID and Client Secret in the YouTube settings first.
errors.youtube_not_configured: YouTube is not set up: log in with Google in Settings.
errors.youtube_client_invalid: Google did not accept the Client ID or Client Secret. Check them in the YouTube settings.
errors.youtube_login_denied: The login was cancelled in the browser. Try again and allow access to YouTube.
errors.youtube_scope_missing: The YouTube access box was not ticked during login. Log in again and tick it.
errors.youtube_no_refresh_token: Google did not issue a key for staying logged in. Log out and log in again.
errors.youtube_no_channel: This Google account has no YouTube channel. Create one on youtube.com or log in with another account.
errors.youtube_port_busy: Could not open a port for the Google login. Close other programs and try again.
errors.youtube_token_invalid: The YouTube login no longer works (revoked or expired). Log in again in Settings.
errors.youtube_unavailable: YouTube is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
errors.youtube_rate_limited: YouTube asks to wait: too many requests. Try again later.
errors.youtube_quota_exceeded: Your Google project's daily YouTube API quota is used up (about 6 uploads a day). Try again tomorrow.
errors.youtube_upload_limit: YouTube has temporarily limited uploads on this channel. Try again later.
errors.youtube_api_disabled: YouTube Data API v3 is not enabled in your Google project. Enable it in Google Cloud.
errors.youtube_permission_denied: YouTube denied access. Check the channel and the permissions you granted.
errors.youtube_video_not_found: The video was not found on YouTube.
errors.youtube_file_too_large: The file is larger than 256 GB; YouTube does not accept it.
errors.youtube_title_too_long: The YouTube title is longer than {{max}} characters ({{length}}). Shorten it.
errors.youtube_description_too_long: The YouTube description is longer than {{max}} bytes ({{length}}). Shorten the text or hashtags.
errors.youtube_angle_brackets: YouTube does not accept < and > in the title or description.
errors.youtube_timeout_uncertain: The connection dropped while uploading to YouTube. The video may have been uploaded: check your channel in YouTube Studio before publishing again.

publish.title: New publication
publish.dropHint: Drop a video onto the window or choose a file
publish.pathHint: In browser dev mode, enter the full path to a file on this computer.
publish.formatHintBot: For Telegram via bot: MP4 up to 50 MB.
publish.formatHintAccount: For Telegram via account: MP4 up to 2 GB.
publish.notConfiguredBot: The Telegram bot is not set up.
publish.notConfiguredAccount: The Telegram account is not set up: channel, api_id, api_hash and sign-in are needed.
publish.scheduleHint: The network itself keeps the post and publishes it at this time, even if the computer is off. Telegram: up to 365 days ahead, Facebook: 10 minutes to 30 days, YouTube: 15 minutes to 365 days.
publish.formatHintFacebook: For Facebook: MP4 up to 1 GB.
publish.notConfiguredFacebook: Facebook is not set up: log in with Facebook.
publish.formatHintYouTube: For YouTube: MP4. YouTube shows vertical or square videos up to 3 minutes as Shorts.
publish.youtubeShort: YouTube: goes out as a Short (vertical, {{seconds}} s).
publish.youtubeVideo: YouTube: goes out as a regular video.
publish.notConfiguredYouTube: YouTube is not set up: log in with Google.

publications.title: Publications
publications.deleteScheduledHint: The scheduled post will be cancelled on the network.
publications.confirmClear: Delete all published and failed records? Scheduled ones stay.
